assets.name: club-v1
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent mascot illustration for a Russian puzzle-game website.
Input image 1 is the exact character-identity and illustration-style reference.
Primary request: render this SAME lime-green furry alien cat in a new seated pose, holding a single golden admission ticket proudly in its two little front paws. The ticket has one simple five-point star emblem only, no text or numbers.
Identity invariants: chubby compact furry cat body; pointed cat ears; exactly TWO long green antennae with large rounded bulb tips; black shiny narrow almond/slit eyes with tiny white catchlights; tiny olive nose and whimsical curved smile; large fluffy tail; lime/chartreuse-green fur with soft yellow-green highlights and darker olive-green tufts. Thick black hand-drawn outlines. Keep the reference's face shape, eye shape, antennae proportions, fur texture and charming slightly mischievous personality. This is not a different cat, not a round yellow mascot, not a human.
Pose and composition: seated, full body, feet and tail entirely visible, holding the golden ticket in front of the belly. Both antenna tips fully inside the frame. Center the complete character on a square canvas and leave at least 12% clear transparent padding around the outermost silhouette in every direction.
Style: same polished hand-drawn 2D cartoon illustration as reference, soft fur shading within clean bold black contours, bright lime green dominant palette.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA alpha; no backdrop, no paper texture, no floor, no ground shadow.
Constraints: exactly one character and one admission ticket. No letters, numbers, typography, logos, watermark, additional decorations or objects. Do not crop any body part or antenna.
assets.processing: PNG copied unchanged; WebP encoded using sharp({ quality: 90, alphaQuality: 100, effort: 6 }), preserving dimensions and alpha. No resizing, recolouring, trimming or background removal.

validation.review: Identity, full-body pose, two antennae, tail, ticket star or celebration marks checked visually. No clipping, letters or backdrop. Generator supplied about 5–6% vertical transparent margin rather than the requested 12%; artwork left unchanged.
